text: Moosetape is the second and final studio album by Indian singer, rapper, and songwriter Sidhu Moose Wala, released independently on 15 May 2021. Moose Wala served as the executive producer, with writing primarily handled by him and other artists, while the tracks were produced by The Kidd, Steel Banglez, Snappy, Wazir Patar, and JB. The album contains 32 tracks, making it Moose Wala's longest studio release. It features guest vocals from Bohemia, Tion Wayne, Stefflon Don, Morrisson, Divine, Raja Kumari, Blockboi Twitch, and Sikander Kahlon. The music video for "GOAT," featuring Jumana Abdu Rahman, surpassed 320 million views on YouTube as of October 2024. The album was announced by Sidhu Moose Wala on 10 March 2021 via his official Instagram account, followed by the unveiling of the official cover art, features, and track credits daily until 23 April 2021. A teaser was released on his YouTube channel on 29 April 2021, announcing the release date and was viewed over a million times within twelve hours. On 5 May 2021, a trailer was released, and the tracklist was revealed on 12 May 2021 through his Instagram. Tracks were released one by one starting on 15 May 2021, scheduled to continue until 21 July 2021. On 18 May 2021, the bonus track "Unfuckwithable," featuring Afsana Khan and produced by The Kidd, was released, with the music video directed by Teji Sandhu. Posthumously, the track "295" charted at 154 on the Billboard Global 200, making Moose Wala the first Punjabi singer to achieve this, as the song title coincidentally matches the date of his death. As of 6 December 2023, Moosetape became the first Indian album to reach 1 billion streams on Spotify. All tracks are written by Sidhu Moose Wala, except where noted. On 4 July 2021, Moose Wala announced the Moosetape World Tour on his Instagram Live, naming it the "Moosetape World Tour" and including regions such as North America, the UK, Canada, Dubai, Australia, and Pakistan. The tour was initially scheduled for 2021 but was postponed due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. BollyBoom Entertainment India later announced the first leg of the tour, featuring concerts in four Indian cities, produced solely by them. On 26 December 2021, Platinum Events Inc. introduced the upcoming world tour. After five shows, on 17 April 2022, Moose Wala officially renamed the tour the "Back To Business World Tour" with Sunny Malton as a supporting act, but the tour was cancelled shortly after his death on 29 May 2022. The set list provided is representative of the show on 26 March 2022 in Dubai, UAE, and is not representative of all concerts during the tour. This list includes planned dates that were subsequently cancelled. On 10 June 2021, Moose Wala collaborated with Spotify, hosted by Vishnu Kausal, with actress Sonam Bajwa also joining the live session. Sales and streaming figures are based on certification alone.
